hero.heroesjourney.batman.description: Become Gotham's Dark Knight: a vow born of grief, forged through training, investigation, and discipline.

quest.heroesjourney.batman.1.title: The Oath
quest.heroesjourney.batman.1.description: That night, coming out of the theatre, my parents ran into the wrong person on the wrong street. There was nothing I could do. I was just a child, frozen, unable to act while their lives were taken. That helplessness will never leave me - but it can become something else. A vow. Never again will I stand still in the face of injustice.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.2.title: In the Shadows
quest.heroesjourney.batman.2.description: Before the martial arts, before the fighting, there were the lessons in espionage and disguise. Crossing a room without a sound, vanishing into a crowd, approaching a target that never once felt my presence. Force wasn't the first thing I was taught. It was the art of not being seen.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.3.title: Body and Discipline
quest.heroesjourney.batman.3.description: Twelve years away from Gotham. Cambridge, the Sorbonne, then the whole world - a tour of the globe where every master pushed me a little further than the last. The FBI felt too slow, too supervised; I quit after six weeks to keep going alone. The body doesn't lie about what it's been put through. Mine carries that training in every muscle.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.4.title: Mind
quest.heroesjourney.batman.4.description: Criminology, forensics, chemistry, the art of disguise - I studied everything that could make me a bloodhound rather than just a fist. A criminal always leaves a trace, a line of reasoning, a flaw. You just have to learn to see it before he does.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.5.title: The Fighter
quest.heroesjourney.batman.5.description: From martial arts masters in the Far East to the League of Assassins, I learned to fight alongside those who mastered violence better than anyone. With the League, I saw exactly where that knowledge could lead - and I chose to keep the fists, without ever adopting their will to kill.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.6.title: A Sign in the Night
quest.heroesjourney.batman.6.description: Sitting in the dark, turning over what I was going to become, I heard the beating of wings before I saw it. A bat, come in through the window I'd left open, that circled the room once before flying back out into the night. Nothing more than a stray animal. And yet, in that exact instant, I knew precisely what I was going to become.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.7.title: Birth of a Symbol
quest.heroesjourney.batman.7.description: I put the chestplate on last, after the cowl, after the gloves. In the window's reflection, it wasn't my face anymore. The city below carried on living, unaware that something had just changed in the darkness above it. Tonight, Gotham no longer has a mere vigilante - it has a symbol.

reward.heroesjourney.batman.stealth_trai: Passive: hostile mobs' detection range toward you is permanently reduced
reward.heroesjourney.batman.threat_glow: Activatable ability: threat sense (reveals nearby hostile mobs through walls for a few seconds)
reward.heroesjourney.batman.martial_arts: Permanent passive: small general damage bonus, regardless of what's in hand
reward.heroesjourney.batman.starter_kit: Unlocks the grapple, batarang, and smoke pebble recipes, plus a starter kit of each. Every piece of armour has its own effect once worn (night vision from the cowl, gliding from the chestplate), and the complete set grants an additional bonus to damage, armour, and knockback resistance.
